subject: Real Madrid expected to trigger EUR 80m clause to bring Nico Paz back from Como
title: Sold cheap, bought back dear

lines.vo: Sold for six million. Possibly bought back for eighty.
Nico Paz came through Real Madrid's academy, then moved to Como in 2024.
Last summer the deal was restructured. The buy-back clause rose to eighty million. That is about thirteen times the fee.
A Spanish radio report says Madrid have already decided to use it. Neither club has confirmed that.
Six goals, eight assists, fourteen club games. That is one goal contribution per game. Eighty million sounds like a discount.
Como say he remains fully their player. Fabregas will hope that stays true until next summer. Chelsea, Manchester United and Arsenal are reportedly watching too.
Your mates will never guess this. Match news and betting tips at aboutfootball dot UK.

facts_used: Mundo Deportivo and ESPN: Madrid expected to use Paz's EUR 80m buy-back or release clause; deadline next summer; neither club confirmed (ev0063)
Paz joined Como for about EUR 6m in 2024; restructured deal last summer raised the clause (ev0063)
A Spanish radio report says Madrid have already decided to use the option, valid only in summer 2027 (ev0063)
Paz has 6 goals and 8 assists in 14 club games this season (ev0063)
Como say he remains fully their player; Chelsea, Manchester United and Arsenal reportedly monitoring him (ev0063)
Cesc Fabregas is Como coach (ev0063 background)
notes: Non-comic, no inserts. Facts unchanged. Arithmetic jokes: 80 / 6 = about 13.3 times (fee is 'about' EUR 6m); 6 goals + 8 assists = 14 in 14 games. Report is unconfirmed by both clubs and the script says so. Reports conflict on how the restructuring changed the clause; script says only that it rose. Source: ev0063.
